item.title: French actor Brigitte Bardot remembered in Canada for fighting seal hunt
item.description: Brigitte Bardot, a French actor and animal rights activist who died Sunday at the age of 91, is being remembered in Canada as a vocal opponent of the country's seal hunt.

item.title: 'Once-in-a-generation moment:' Rare bird flittering around Vancouver park draws crowd
item.description: VANCOUVER — Dozens of birders flocked to Vancouver’s Sunset Beach Park on Sunday to catch a rare glimpse of a bird that avian enthusiasts say has never been recorded in Canada before.

item.title: NHL roundup: Kucherov, Goncalves power Lightning to 5-4 shootout win over Canadiens
item.description: TAMPA, Fla. (AP) — Nikita Kucherov scored twice, Gage Goncalves added two assists and had the deciding goal in the shootout as the Tampa Bay Lightning held off the Montreal Canadiens 5-4 on Sunday. Oliver Bjorkstrand had two assists for Tampa Bay.

item.title: Chinese military stages drills around Taiwan to warn 'external forces' after US, Japan tensions
item.description: HONG KONG (AP) — China's military on Monday dispatched air, navy and rocket troops to conduct joint military drills around the island of Taiwan, a move Beijing called a “stern warning” against separatist and “external interference” forces.

item.title: Hawaii hopes stricter laws will quiet illegal fireworks after deadly New Year's Eve blast
item.description: HONOLULU (AP) — Mike Lambert heard fewer illegal fireworks exploding in his suburban Honolulu neighborhood in the months after a chain of blasts at a house party last New Year's Eve led to the deaths of six people , including a 3-year-old boy.

item.title: What music and television to stream: A New Year's Eve tradition
item.description: It's the end of the year and there are fewer new streaming options headed to a device near you. But it's a great time to catch up on some of best movies, television, music and video games of 2025.

item.title: Out with the old: With 2026 nigh, here's some wide-ranging intel on managing transitions
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — It's that time — December's waning days, when we prepare to turn the calendar page. Many Americans take stock, review goals accomplished and unmet, ponder hopes and plans.
